scope: Category-independent source-to-reconstruction asset and scene-graph consistency
identity_policy: Match source-indexed IDs only within the same scene, survey scope and registered coordinate frame. Cross-scene reuse applies to rules, not object IDs.

dimensions.implemented: ID/category comparison; unmatched is extra only when source inventory is complete
Registered centres, dimensions and quaternion orientation; contour/shape collectors pending
Provided material labels plus existing ROI pixels; automatic attribute extraction pending
Provided relation-set comparison; geometric relation inference pending
Provided state-label comparison; capture states must be aligned
Provided affordance-label comparison only; physical proof stays in physics/task tracks
Explicit inventory completeness and required-property gaps; automatic visibility collector pending

threshold_policy: Freeze tolerance by category, scale, visibility and task before scoring; do not apply button tolerances to walls or furniture.
unknown_policy: Unknown source properties and incomplete inventory require evidence. An empty affordance list means explicitly no supported interaction, not missing annotation.

cross_scene_tests.current_status: Synthetic schema/unit cases only; real cross-scene generalization unverified
